normalization_plan.reason: sender is the address parameter bound to the _transfer function and carries msg.sender-derived data
recipient is the destination parameter of _transfer used for balance and tax decisions
amount is the value parameter of _transfer propagated into feeless and taxed paths
addy is the address parameter written into the is_auth authorization mapping
booly is the boolean parameter stored in the is_auth authorization mapping
tkn is the target token parameter of the external router swap in claimFarmedToken
slot selects is_claimable and isAuthorized checks inside claimFarmedToken
addys is the recipient array iterated by payable send in the native airdrop
tax is the local multiplier passed into _calculateFee for the fee computation
impact is derived from get_weth_price_impact and adjusts the sell tax in _taxedTransfer
tokenToSwap is the computed amount driving the contract swap and liquidity split
sellAmount is the parameter that bounds tokenToSwap when sellPeg is enabled
amount is the local marketing balance forwarded through the low-level call
qty is the token amount divided across recipients in the ERC20 airdrop loop
token is the arbitrary ERC20 address transferred to recipients in the airdrop
